# Albert Jonathan — Full-Stack Engineer & Assistant Lead

> Personal portfolio, technical background, living in Malaysia field guides, and curated zero-adware web tools by Albert Jonathan.

## Overview

Albert Jonathan is a Full-Stack Engineer & Assistant Lead based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia with 6+ years of production experience across React, TypeScript, PHP/Laravel, Next.js, Svelte, and Java Spring Boot. He specializes in enterprise frontend architecture, legacy modernization, and banking microservices at Accenture.

## Key Links & Navigation

- [Portfolio Home](https://albertjonathan.dev/): Overview of full-stack engineering background, banking project delivery at Accenture, and contact information.
- [Curated Tools Directory](https://albertjonathan.dev/#/tools): Curated catalog of zero-adware web tools for daily media manipulation, video compression, format conversions, and developer utilities.
- [Curriculum Vitae (PDF)](https://albertjonathan.dev/Albert_Jonathan_CV.pdf): Complete professional CV download.

## Field Notes & Malaysia Guides (Bahasa Indonesia)

- [3 Jalur Kerja di Malaysia: Pekerjaan Kasar, BPO, dan Sesuai Keahlian](https://albertjonathan.dev/#/articles/3-jalur-kerja-di-malaysia): Panduan komprehensif 3 jalur kerja di Malaysia untuk orang Indonesia: persyaratan, benchmark gaji, regulasi cooling-off period visa ESD, dan platform cari kerja.
- [Panduan Hidup di Malaysia: Transportasi, Mobil & SIM, Belanja, dan Komunitas](https://albertjonathan.dev/#/articles/panduan-hidup-transportasi-belanja-malaysia): Catatan praktis harian seputar transportasi kereta & bus MyRapid, tips kartu TnG NFC, biaya beli mobil, transfer SIM ke JPJ, marketplace barang bekas, dan grup komunitas ekspat.

## Recommended Tools & Resources

- [8mb.video](https://8mb.video): In-browser two-pass video compression down to 8MB/25MB for Discord and Slack without watermarks.
- [Videy](https://videy.co): Free, zero-signup instant video hosting for quick clips.
- [VERT.sh](https://vert.sh/convert): Private in-browser open-source file converter without cloud server uploads.
- [Lark Suite](https://www.larksuite.com): All-in-one collaborative workspace combining docs, chat, and relational tables.
- [CyberChef](https://gchq.github.io/CyberChef): The Cyber Swiss Army Knife by GCHQ for encoding, decoding, encryption, and data parsing.
- [Cobalt](https://cobalt.tools): Ad-free, open-source media downloader for YouTube, Twitter/X, Instagram, and TikTok.
- [Docmost](https://docmost.com/docs/): Self-hosted open-source collaborative wiki and knowledge base platform.
- [9router](https://github.com/decolua/9router): AI router and fallback gateway connecting coding agents to 40+ LLM providers.
- [Goose AI Agent](https://goose-docs.ai): Open-source native developer agent by Block for terminal automation and desktop workflows.
- [ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers](https://www.deeplearning.ai/short-courses/chatgpt-prompt-engineering-for-developers/): Free foundational course by Andrew Ng and Isa Fulford on LLM prompt engineering.
- [Exercism](https://exercism.org/dashboard): 100% free code practice and mentorship across 70+ programming languages.
- [anti-slop](https://github.com/miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop): Oxlint AST rules to reject AI code slop and maintain strict codebase hygiene.
